channel.title: World Boxing News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from World Boxing News (worldboxingnews.net)

item.title: Kabayel vs Knyba – WBC Interim Heavyweight Scorecard
item.description: Follow Agit Kabayel vs Damian Knyba live from Oberhausen, Germany. Get real-time round-by-round scoring, unofficial tallies, and updates.

item.title: Kabayel Stops Knyba in Round 3, Awaits Usyk chance
item.description: Agit Kabayel earned a third-round stoppage over Damian Knyba in Oberhausen and now eyes a potential clash with Oleksandr Usyk.

item.title: Road Warrior Dalton Smith Stuns Matias, Wins WBC Super Lightweight Title
item.description: Dalton Smith stopped Subriel Matias in the sixth round to claim the WBC super lightweight title at Barclays Center, marking a career-defining victory.

item.title: Mike Tyson Flattening Floyd Mayweather Would Be a Boxing Disaster
item.description: A Mike Tyson knockout of Floyd Mayweather would not be nostalgia or spectacle. It would risk damaging one of boxing’s cleanest legacies for cash.

item.title: Spadafora Calls on Mayweather for Exhibition, Reveals Whitaker Insight
item.description: Paul Spadafora says his boxing style can trouble Floyd Mayweather as he calls for an exhibition and explains the influence of Pernell Whitaker.

item.title: Manny Pacquiao Refused to Let a Liquid-Diet Recovery End His Career
item.description: Manny Pacquiao refused to let a a liquid-diet recovery did not end his career as he later returned to fight for a WBC title at age 46.

item.title: Ryan Garcia Lands WBC Title Shot With No Official Win Since December 2023
item.description: Ryan Garcia will challenge Mario Barrios for the WBC welterweight title despite not recording an official victory since December 2023.

item.title: Ramírez Thought ‘Inferior’ Opetaia Was Next, Then Came the Benavidez Offer
item.description: Gilberto Ramírez says he expected a fight with Jai Opetaia before being surprised by the offer to face David Benavidez on May 2 in Las Vegas.

item.title: The Other Itauma: How Moses’ Rise Left His Older Brother Behind
item.description: As Moses Itauma accelerates toward a world title at 21, his older brother Karol’s career tells a quieter story of boxing’s unforgiving margins.

item.title: Anthony Ogogo’s Third Act: After Boxing’s Rock Bottom and AEW
item.description: After boxing injuries and an interrupted AEW run, Anthony Ogogo reflects on his lowest point and explains how his career’s third act helps others.
